name: attachment_pending
definition:
SELECT href,
    kind,
    law_guid,
    label,
    priority,
    listed_at
   FROM boe.attachment_target t
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM boe.attachment a
          WHERE a.href = t.href));

name: current_law
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (guid) id,
    guid,
    snapshot_sha256,
    url,
    name,
    name_en,
    description_en,
    summary,
    category_path,
    issued_raw,
    issued_hijri,
    issued_gregorian,
    published_raw,
    published_hijri,
    published_gregorian,
    status_at_source,
    instruments,
    article_count,
    parse_flags,
    parsed_at
   FROM boe.law
  ORDER BY guid, parsed_at DESC, id DESC;

name: current_match
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (guid) id,
    guid,
    hakeem_system_id,
    method,
    candidates,
    decided_by,
    decided_at
   FROM boe.match
  ORDER BY guid, decided_at DESC, id DESC;

name: current_owner_decision
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (proposal_id) id,
    proposal_id,
    decision,
    corrected_text,
    owner_note,
    decided_by,
    decided_at
   FROM boe.owner_decision
  ORDER BY proposal_id, decided_at DESC, id DESC;

name: v_amendment
definition:
SELECT l.guid AS law_guid,
    l.name AS law_name,
    l.status_at_source,
    u.seq AS unit_seq,
    u.heading AS unit_heading,
    u.css_class AS unit_class,
    n.id AS note_id,
    n.note_seq,
    n.note_text,
    n.effect AS parser_effect,
    n.instrument_kind,
    n.instrument_no,
    n.instrument_date_hijri,
    n.needs_review,
    COALESCE(p.new_text, n.new_text) AS new_text,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT n.needs_review THEN 'محسوم من الملاحظة'::text
            ELSE p.confidence
        END AS confidence,
    p.id AS proposal_id,
    p.category,
    p.effect AS proposed_effect,
    p.reason,
    p.image_url,
    v.status AS vision_status,
    v.instrument_seen,
    v.instrument_match,
    v.verify_verdict,
    d.decision AS owner_decision,
    d.corrected_text,
    l.url AS source_url
   FROM boe.amendment_note n
     JOIN boe.law l ON l.id = n.law_id
     JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq
     LEFT JOIN boe.review_proposal p ON p.note_id = n.id
     LEFT JOIN boe.vision_reading v ON v.note_id = n.id
     LEFT JOIN boe.current_owner_decision d ON d.proposal_id = p.id;

name: v_coverage
definition:
SELECT 'أنظمة محللة'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.current_law
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'مواد'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.unit
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'ملاحظات تعديل'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.amendment_note
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'ملاحظات تحتاج مراجعة'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.amendment_note
  WHERE amendment_note.needs_review
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'اقتراحات مراجعة'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.review_proposal
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'قراءات صور الأدوات'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.vision_reading
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'قرارات المالك'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.owner_decision
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'مرفقات مقروءة'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.attachment
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'صفحات مرفقات'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.attachment_page
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'مرفقات لم تُقرأ بعد'::text AS item,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM boe.attachment_pending;

name: article_judgments
definition:
SELECT legal_system_id,
    article_number,
    article_id,
    count(DISTINCT judgment_id) AS judgment_count,
    array_agg(DISTINCT judgment_id) AS judgment_ids
   FROM judgment_article_links l
  GROUP BY legal_system_id, article_number, article_id;

name: preamble_unit_current
definition:
SELECT u.id,
    u.edition_id,
    u.system_id,
    u.parent_id,
    u.unit_type,
    u.ordinal,
    u.instrument_index,
    u.instrument_kind,
    u.instrument_number,
    u.instrument_date_hijri,
    u.label_ar,
    u.number,
    u.text_raw,
    u.text_normalized,
    u.path,
    u.anchor,
    u.char_start,
    u.char_end,
    u.created_at
   FROM preamble_unit u
     JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (preamble_edition.system_id) preamble_edition.id
           FROM preamble_edition
          ORDER BY preamble_edition.system_id, preamble_edition.created_at DESC, preamble_edition.id DESC) cur ON cur.id = u.edition_id
  WHERE u.unit_type <> 'issuing_instrument'::text;

name: amendment_decision
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (op_id) op_id,
    decision,
    corrected,
    reviewer,
    decided_at
   FROM uqn_fix.amendment_review
  ORDER BY op_id, decided_at DESC, id DESC;
